items.t: LIVE: Florida attorney general, Pinellas sheriff announce drug arrests
items.x: TAMPA, Fla. (WFLA) -- Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier and Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri are announcing drug arrests at a Tampa news conference.

items.t: The pope's alma mater is a basketball powerhouse. This week, Villanova opens their season near the Vatican.
items.x: Villanova University, where Pope Leo went to school, will get a chance to connect with him again as the school's basketball team plays near the Vatican.

items.t: German climber dies in nearly 5,000-foot fall a day after summiting Nepal mountain
items.x: A 57-year-old German climber died in a nearly 5,000-foot fall on Nepal’s Ama Dablam mountain one day after reaching its summit.

items.t: Florida Amendment 3 promises relief for homeowners, draws criticism from first responders
items.x: Amendment 3 would significantly increase Florida’s homestead property tax exemption, potentially saving qualifying homeowners money, while raising concerns about funding for essential local services.

items.t: 'Team Moms: Baseball' cast previews friendships, rivalries and drama in reality TV show
items.x: The cast of "Team Moms: Baseball" shares what fans can expect in the first season of the reality TV show, which is now streaming on Paramount+.

items.t: After 63 years in the sky, American Airlines' most senior flight attendant takes her final flight
items.x: Carol Fair ended her 63-year career as a flight attendant with a celebrated last journey on American Airlines Flight 733 from London to Charlotte, North Carolina.

items.t: Hillsborough County Hiking Spree returns Nov. 1
items.x: You can choose from 25 trails throughout the county to earn a reward for exploring the local outdoors.

items.t: How to get a free reusable cup on Starbucks Red Cup Day
items.x: Starbucks’ annual Red Cup Day is returning for the holiday season. On Red Cup Day, customers who purchase any handcrafted holiday beverage can receive a collectible reusable holiday cup while supplies last. The promotion arrives shortly…

items.t: 'Nocturne' cast previews crime thriller
items.x: Liev Schreiber, Zazie Beetz, Stephen Graham and Rory Culkin preview crime thriller "Nocturne," which premieres Friday, Oct. 30, on Apple TV.

items.t: Emmy winner Michael Chiklis previews role in Liam Neeson-starring action thriller 'The Mongoose'
items.x: Michael Chiklis previews his villainous role in "The Mongoose," starring Liam Neeson, which opens in theaters Friday, Oct. 30.

items.t: Carnival will launch dynamic pricing on drink packages, Wi-Fi later this year
items.x: Carnival Cruise Line is the latest company to bring dynamic pricing to customers, saying drink packages and Wi-Fi costs will change depending on the trip.

items.t: 10 Tampa Bay Weather: Breezy conditions continue with low-end rain chances this week
items.x: Gusty northeast winds will stick around through midweek, with scattered showers becoming more likely as humidity climbs mid to late week

items.t: FTC, 20 states, including Florida, sue Dollar General, claiming customers overcharged
items.x: The complaint alleges Dollar General charged customers more at the register than the prices listed on shelves and price tags.

items.t: 2 charged with UK national security offenses over incident at US-run military base in England
items.x: U.K. prosecutors said two men have been charged with national security offenses over an incident at RAF Fairford. The facility is a U.S.-run military base.

items.t: Dolly Parton’s niece realized singer had cancer upon revealing own diagnosis
items.x: “She worried more about everybody else," Danielle Parton said.

items.t: Florida man shoots at neighbors from backyard with AR-style gun, deputies say
items.x: A Florida man was arrested over the weekend after shooting at neighbors with an AR-15-style rifle from his backyard.

items.t: PEOPLE announces its 2026 Sexiest Man Alive
items.x: The selection for PEOPLE's Sexiest Man Alive was announced Tuesday morning, with the headline reading, in part, "No Second Opinion Needed."

items.t: Ex-FBI officials charged in the case about Hunter Biden's laptop are due back in court
items.x: Two FBI agents charged with lying to Congress about investigations into Hunter Biden are due back in court for a preliminary hearing Tuesday.

items.t: Troy Aikman chokes up during 'Monday Night Football' while discussing former colleague's death
items.x: Troy Aikman appeared to be fighting back tears during Monday night's Dallas Cowboys vs. Philadelphia Eagles game following the death of a colleague.

items.t: Nicki Minaj's role in Trump's political circle divides fans
items.x: In 2020, during his first term, Minaj said she would not “jump on the Donald Trump bandwagon."
